# `browser-tab`

**Usage**: `browser-tab [FLAGS] <SUBCOMMAND>`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab [FLAGS] <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Flags

### `--json`

Emit machine-readable JSON output

### `-q --quiet`

Suppress non-error output

### `-v --verbose`

Log debug-level info to stderr

### `--no-color`

Disable colors
